summary: BioMar has officially formalized its acquisition of full control over Alitec Pargua, a Chilean aquaculture feed producer. This move represents a significant expansion of BioMar's operations in the South American salmon farming market through complete ownership of the company's operations and assets in the region. This consolidation strengthens BioMar's strategic position in Chilean aquaculture feed production and supply chain management in Pargua and surrounding areas.
title: BioMar oficializa control de la totalidad de Alitec Pargua
